sourceLineage.origin: Steel Dynamics investor relations — Q2 2026 results

observations: Steel fabrication operating income was $85M in Q2 2026 versus $90M in Q1 as higher shipments/steady pricing were offset by higher steel input costs.
Fabrication order backlog was nearly 45% higher than a year earlier and extended into Q1 2027.
Management cited improving demand across commercial construction, data centers, manufacturing, warehousing and healthcare, plus reshoring and infrastructure investment as support.
factors: vertical exposure to steel, recycling and fabrication can capture multiple points in the value chain
risks: higher steel input costs compressed fabrication operating income despite shipment growth
construction and steel demand remain cyclical and policy-sensitive
backlog quality depends on cancellation behavior and margin at conversion
contradictions: Strengthening backlog and shipments did not produce sequential fabrication operating-income growth because input costs rose.
unknowns: margin embedded in the expanded backlog
share of backlog attributable specifically to data centers versus other end markets

recommendation.reason: Primary evidence source-addresses demand, backlog and cost-pressure signals for factor/risk underwriting.
